title: RecordingController: wire audio, WAV, transcriber and database
description: A single, testable class that runs a recording session: creates the session row, writes the WAV, feeds the transcriber, stores each final segment immediately, and exposes live state for the UI (goals 1, 3).
steps: Create `recording/RecordingState.kt`: `enum class RecordingPhase { IDLE, LOADING, RECORDING, STOPPING }` and `data class RecordingState(val phase: RecordingPhase = IDLE, val sessionId: Long? = null, val elapsedMs: Long = 0, val partialText: String = "", val finalLines: List<String> = emptyList(), val lastCompletedSessionId: Long? = null, val error: String? = null)`.

Create `recording/RecordingStore.kt`: `interface RecordingStore { suspend fun createSession(title: String, language: String): Long; suspend fun audioPath(sessionId: Long): String; suspend fun addSegment(sessionId: Long, startMs: Long, endMs: Long, text: String): Long; suspend fun finishRecording(sessionId: Long, durationMs: Long) }` and make `SessionRepository` implement it (add `audioPath` returning the session's `audioPath`).

Create `recording/RecordingController.kt`: `class RecordingController(private val audioSource: AudioSource, private val transcriberFactory: TranscriberFactory, private val store: RecordingStore, private val language: () -> String, private val asrDispatcher: CoroutineDispatcher, private val clock: () -> Long = System::currentTimeMillis)`. Expose `val state: StateFlow<RecordingState>`.

`fun start(scope: CoroutineScope)`: ignore unless phase is IDLE. Set LOADING (clear error, finalLines, partial). Launch in scope: create the transcriber with `withContext(asrDispatcher) { transcriberFactory.create(language) }`; create the session with `store.createSession(title, language())` where title = `"Recording " + SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm", Locale.US).format(Date(clock()))`; open a `WavWriter(File(store.audioPath(id)))`; set RECORDING with sessionId. Then collect `audioSource.chunks()`: write to WAV, `transcriber.accept(chunk.toFloatSamples())` on `asrDispatcher`, handle events (Partial -> partialText; Final -> `store.addSegment(...)` and append text to finalLines), elapsedMs = samplesToMs(wav.samplesWritten). Keep the collecting `Job` in a field.

`suspend fun stop(): Long?`: if phase is not RECORDING return null. Set STOPPING, `job.cancelAndJoin()`, then `transcriber.finish()` (handle events as above), close transcriber and WAV writer, `store.finishRecording(id, durationMs)`, then set state to `RecordingState(phase = IDLE, lastCompletedSessionId = id)` and return id.

Errors: if anything throws during start/collection (except CancellationException), close what was opened, call `store.finishRecording(id, samplesToMs(written))` if the session was created (so partial results are kept), and set `RecordingState(phase = IDLE, error = e.message ?: "Recording failed")`.
`fun consumeCompleted()` sets `lastCompletedSessionId = null` (the UI calls it after navigating).

In `AppContainer` add `val recordingController = RecordingController(MicAudioSource(), transcriberFactory, sessionRepository, { settingsRepository.settings.value.asrLanguage }, Dispatchers.Default.limitedParallelism(1))`.

Write `recording/RecordingControllerTest.kt` as a plain JVM test (no Robolectric): a `FakeRecordingStore` (in-memory list of segments, audio paths in a TemporaryFolder, records finishRecording calls); a fake AudioSource whose `chunks()` is `channel.receiveAsFlow()` of a `Channel<ShortArray>` you send 1600-sample chunks to; a fake TranscriberFactory returning a fake StreamingTranscriber that emits a Final every 3rd chunk; one `StandardTestDispatcher(testScheduler)` used for the start scope (`backgroundScope`) and asrDispatcher; call `advanceUntilIdle()` after sending chunks.
acceptanceCriteria: Test: start → phase LOADING then RECORDING with a sessionId; after 6 chunks finalLines has 2 entries and the fake store has 2 segments for the session
Test: stop returns the id, phase IDLE, `lastCompletedSessionId` set, `finishRecording(id, 600)` recorded by the fake store, WAV file length 44 + 6*1600*2
Test: a transcriber factory that throws gives phase IDLE and `error` equal to the exception message
Test: calling start twice does not create a second session; stop when IDLE returns null
